subject: Supressing OAuth browser window possible with Shiny?

messages.author: 2bc90fc33b001f12
messages.subject: Supressing OAuth browser window possible with Shiny?
parts:
Hello all,

Not sure if this has been asked before.

I am using the 'Rfacebook' package which pop-ups a browser window after the authentication is
successful through OAuth. I don't know if this will look nice (or) even allowed while working with
a web application interface when suddenly a browser window pops-up on the user interface.
I am looking at Shiny for being the web application UI, and I am wondering if there's a way in
Shiny to suppress this browser window, or process/redirect it in a graceful manner such that it
does not produce a not-so-nice UI effect....

Any responses/experiences would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks & Best Regards,
Venkat.
